extensionDescription.message: Send open PDFs or local PDF files directly to your Paperless-ngx server.

badgeStopped.message: Paperless Upload: Queue stopped. Reopen the popup.

waitForTransfer.message: Wait until the current transfer finishes.

allowServer.message: Allow access to your Paperless server.

restartUpload.message: The upload destination changed. Start the upload again.

localTabsSkipped.message: Local tabs were skipped. Allow access to local PDFs to include them.

noPdfTabs.message: No PDF tabs found in this window.

allowWebsites.message: Website access is missing. Try uploading all PDF tabs again and allow access in Chrome.

cannotCheckAgain.message: This import status cannot be checked again.

batchLimit.message: The selected PDFs cannot exceed $LIMIT$ MiB in total.

tabPdfChanged.message: The PDF in the tab changed or was closed. Reopen the extension.

tabPdfLoading.message: The PDF is still loading. Wait a moment and try again.

cacheUnavailable.message: The cached PDF is no longer available. Save it from the PDF viewer and drag it here.

uiSetupHint.message: Set up once to send PDFs directly to your server.

uiServerHelp.message: The base URL of your server, including a subpath if needed.

uiFindToken.message: In Paperless, open My Profile → API Token.

uiHttpWarning.message: HTTP sends your token and PDFs without encryption.

uiConnectionAccess.message: Chrome asks once for access to all sites so you can upload PDFs without further prompts.

uiLocalToken.message: Your token is stored only in this Chrome profile.

uiWebAccess.message: Chrome asks once for access to all sites.

uiImportOtherServer.message: This import belongs to a different Paperless server.

uiRecheckNamedImport.message: Check the import status of $NAME$ again

uiOpenPaperlessTab.message: Open Paperless in a new tab

uiPreparing.message: Preparing… Keep this window open for a moment.

uiKeepTokenHelp.message: Leave blank to keep the saved token.

uiNewTokenHelp.message: Enter an API token for the new Paperless address.

uiSiteDenied.message: Site access was denied. Grant access in Chrome.

uiSaveChoiceFailed.message: Your choice could not be saved.

uiTabAccessDenied.message: Access to PDF tabs was denied.

uiLocalAccessDenied.message: Access to local PDFs was denied.

uiEnableFileAccess.message: In chrome://extensions, open Details for Paperless Upload and turn on “Allow access to file URLs”. You can also drag the PDF here.

actionFailed.message: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

pdfTooLarge.message: This PDF is too large. Each file can be up to 50 MiB.

invalidPdf.message: This file is not a PDF. Please choose a PDF file.

invalidServerUrl.message: Use an HTTP or HTTPS address without credentials, a query string or a fragment.

invalidTokenFormat.message: Enter your Paperless API token without spaces.

sourceFetchFailed.message: The PDF could not be retrieved again. Download it from the open PDF viewer, then select it here or drag it in.

sourceExpired.message: The original PDF address is unavailable (HTTP $status$). The link may have expired or been valid only once. Nothing was sent to Paperless. Download the PDF from the open viewer, then select it here or drag it in.

sourceDenied.message: The website denied access to the PDF (HTTP $status$). Your session may have expired. Nothing was sent to Paperless. Download the PDF from the open viewer, then select it here or drag it in.

sourceHttpError.message: The website could not provide the PDF (HTTP $status$). Nothing was sent to Paperless. Download the PDF from the open viewer, then select it here or drag it in.

sourceInterrupted.message: The PDF download was interrupted. Download it from the open PDF viewer, then select it here or drag it in.

apiInvalidToken.message: The API token is invalid. Check the token in settings.

apiDenied.message: Access denied. Check the token permissions and your access to the server.

apiTooLarge.message: The server rejected the file size. Check its upload limit.

apiRateLimited.message: Too many requests. Try again later.

apiRejected.message: Paperless rejected the request (HTTP $status$). Check the address and, if necessary, the Paperless logs.

apiUnreachable.message: Paperless could not be reached. Check the address, HTTPS certificate and network connection.

apiRedirect.message: The server redirected the API request. Use the direct Paperless base URL. Any sign-in gateway must allow token access to /api/.

apiNotFound.message: No Paperless API responded at this address. Enter the base URL, including the installation path if needed.

importUnavailable.message: Import status is unavailable. The PDF was sent. Check the import in Paperless.

importRetrying.message: Import status is temporarily unavailable. It will be checked again automatically …

importStatusDenied.message: You do not have access to the import status. Check the API token and task permissions in Paperless.

importFailed.message: Paperless could not import the PDF. Check the task in Paperless.

importDuplicate.message: Already exists. Paperless detected a duplicate.

importCancelled.message: The import was cancelled in Paperless.

uploadUncertain.message: No confirmation received. Check your Paperless inbox before sending the file again.

downloadInterrupted.message: The download was interrupted. Please try again.

setupServer.message: Set up your Paperless server first.

destinationChanged.message: The upload destination has changed or is missing. Select the PDF again.

sourceNotPdf.message: No PDF was received. The website may have returned a sign-in page. Save the PDF from the viewer and select it here.

fileUnavailable.message: The file is no longer available. Select it again.

importTakingLonger.message: The PDF was sent. The import is taking longer. Check its status in Paperless.

uploadOtherServer.message: This upload belongs to a different Paperless server.
